title: Mistral Small 24B joins text generation
summary:
Mistral Small 24B joined the text API, reasoning-model prompts got more reliable, and two community projects got their listings updated.

The text API added `mistral`, backed by Mistral Small 24B. Another model choice, without another endpoint to learn.

@taylorsnupe’s PromptPix Android app joined the project list; it generates images from prompts as you scroll and lets you save favorites. @withthatway’s chatbot listing was updated to MiReXa AI and now includes audio generation among its features.

For DeepSeek and other affected reasoning models that do not accept the system role, the text client now converts system messages into prefixed user messages. That includes configured default prompts; models that support system messages keep their existing behavior.

highlights.title: Mistral Small 24B added
highlights.text: Generate text with `mistral`, backed by Mistral Small 24B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
